name: Ontology Detective - Datapolis P.I.
description: 🕵️ You are Detective Sherlock Graph at Datapolis P.I. Model real Fabric Ontologies, ingest case-file evidence, write KQL semantic queries to identify the culprit. 10 cases, noir tone, encrypted solutions.

skills: Familiar with the concept of a knowledge graph

learning_objectives: Model entity types, properties and relationships in Fabric Ontology
Distinguish facts from observations / temporal events
Write KQL semantic queries over an ontology event store
Use inheritance, role-playing relationships, and sameAs aliases
Detect cycles and reason about indirect relations

items.name: Datapolis_DetectiveLH
items.description: 10 case folders (case01/ .. case10/) with witness CSVs, camera logs, phone records + encrypted solution.json.enc

items.name: Datapolis_DetectiveEH
items.description: Telemetry of cases attempted, accusations made, detective rank

items.name: DetectiveOntology
items.description: Empty Digital Twin Builder ontology — player adds entity types, properties, and relationships case by case (single ontology, single namespace by design)

items.name: OntologyDetective_Seed
items.description: Generates 10 synthetic noir case files (CSVs) + encrypted solution.json.enc in Datapolis_DetectiveLH (run once)

items.name: OntologyDetective_CaseFile
items.description: Per-case noir briefings + ready-to-run ingestion cells + detective.accuse(name) judge

items.name: OntologyDetective_Dashboard
items.description: Cases solved, Detective Rank, accuracy, ontology minimalism scoreboard

eventTypes.name: OntologyExtended
eventTypes.description: Player added entity types / properties / relationships for this case

eventTypes.name: EvidenceIngested
eventTypes.description: Ready-cell loaded case CSVs into ontology instances

eventTypes.name: CaseSolved
eventTypes.description: Correct accusation + valid supporting KQL query

cases.name: The Stolen Pie
cases.concept: Entity types + properties + one instance per type (tutorial)

cases.name: Hit & Run on Vector Avenue
cases.concept: Multi-source events converging on one Vehicle entity

cases.name: The Anonymous Blackmail
cases.concept: Reasoning: deduce missing property via transitive relations

cases.name: Conspiracy at the Senate
cases.concept: Cycle detection in the graph (bribes loop)

cases.name: The Final Heist (BOSS)
cases.concept: Complex multi-domain case in a SINGLE ontology with 3 sub-namespaces (Bank, Police, Telecom) — must reason across all of them

validation_strategy.encrypted_solutions: solution.json.enc per case, key = SHA256(player_id || case_id || workspace_id) — only the judge can decrypt after accusation
validation_strategy.ingestion_gate: Ready ingestion cell verifies entity types/properties exist before loading instances (forces ontology design first)
validation_strategy.query_check: Player saves their KQL query into a tagged variable; judge re-executes it to confirm the accused person is indeed returned by their query

tone: noir — gritty Datapolis P.I. agency, rainy streets, hard-boiled monologues; each briefing in pulp detective style
post_deploy_steps: Run OntologyDetective_Seed notebook once to generate the 10 case files in Datapolis_DetectiveLH
Open OntologyDetective_CaseFile notebook and read Case 1 briefing (The Stolen Pie tutorial)
Open DetectiveOntology in Fabric Digital Twin Builder UI and add the entity types + relationships required by the briefing
Run the 'Ingest Evidence' ready-cell — it loads case CSVs into your ontology instances
Write a KQL query on the ontology event store to identify the culprit, save it to the SOLUTION_QUERY variable
Call detective.accuse('<Person Name>') — judge validates and emits CaseSolved or WrongAccusation
Solve all 10 cases to be promoted to Commissioner
